project.name: SaaS后台管理系统设计稿
project.styleDefinitionBrief: SaaS电商后台管理系统，Element UI经典蓝白风格，深色侧边栏+白色内容区，标准管理后台密度
project.designRead: B2B SaaS admin panel / operations team / clean enterprise utility / high density / avoid playful or editorial aesthetics

pages.title: 后台管理布局
pages.visualNorthStar: Classic admin shell: dark sidebar with collapsible menu tree, white header with breadcrumb, tab navigation, and main content area with dashboard cards
pages.soulElement: Sidebar uses gradient dark theme (#304156 to #1F2D3D) with active menu highlight using brand blue, creating a professional enterprise management feel

pages.title: 用户管理
pages.visualNorthStar: Standard CRUD table page: filter card at top, tabbed channel counts, sortable data table with avatar+name composite cells, status tags, and pagination
pages.soulElement: User info column merges avatar, nickname, and user ID into one compact cell, maximizing information density while keeping scannability

pages.title: 背包管理
pages.visualNorthStar: Inventory management page with filter card, stat summary cards row, tabbed data table, and slide-out detail drawer with timeline
pages.soulElement: Stat cards use colored icon circles to create visual rhythm before the dense table, making key metrics instantly scannable
